snippet.title: Lokko - GDC Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10013643

Meet three brand-new characters joining the adventure: Speedy, the lightning-fast runner; Ivan, the unstoppable force; and Doggo, your loyal (and chaotic) canine companion.

But that’s not all…

Introducing the all-new 2D Level Editor! Build, design, and share your own levels with endless possibilities. Whether you’re crafting tricky challenges or wild playgrounds, the power is in your hands.

New characters. New Dimensions.

#ps5 #ps5games #lokko
